stemMd: A test independently succeeds on each trial with probability 0.8. What is the probability of at least one success in two trials?
explanationMd: Use the complement. Both trials fail with probability 0.2×0.2=0.04 by independence. Therefore at least one succeeds with probability 1−0.04=0.96. This includes both one-success and two-success outcomes.

distractorRationale.c: This is the probability both trials succeed.
distractorRationale.b: This is the probability of exactly one success.
distractorRationale.a: This is the probability neither succeeds.
